# GitHub Repository Description

> The sandbox token lacks `repo:admin` scope, so these must be applied manually:
> **Repo → About (⚙ gear icon, top-right of the repo page)**

---

## Short description (used in the About box, ≤ 350 chars)

```
🏍️ RideJaunm — UI/UX strategy & Figma design system blueprint for a Nepal-focused motorcycle riding app. Curvy/Supercurvy route planning, 3D live GPS HUD, offline Himalayan maps, group tracking, rider community feed, and a dual-mode (cellular + Bluetooth mesh) SOS. Design direction: Himalayan-Tactical Tech.
```

## Ultra-short alternative (≤ 120 chars)

```
Design system & UX strategy for RideJaunm — a curvy-route, offline-first, mesh-SOS riding app for Nepal. 🏍️🇳🇵
```

## One-line CLI (run locally with an admin-scoped `gh` login)

```bash
gh repo edit dz-srizon/RideJaunm-Design \
  --description "🏍️ RideJaunm — UI/UX strategy & Figma design system blueprint for a Nepal-focused motorcycle riding app. Curvy/Supercurvy route planning, 3D live GPS HUD, offline Himalayan maps, group tracking, rider community feed, and a dual-mode (cellular + Bluetooth mesh) SOS. Design direction: Himalayan-Tactical Tech." \
  --homepage "https://github.com/dz-srizon/RideJaunm-Design#readme" \
  --add-topic design-system --add-topic uiux --add-topic figma \
  --add-topic mobile-app-design --add-topic motorcycle --add-topic nepal \
  --add-topic offline-first --add-topic design-tokens --add-topic maps \
  --add-topic ux-strategy --add-topic wireframes --add-topic accessibility
```

## Social preview card (Settings → Social preview, 1280×640)

Suggested composition, per the brand direction:

- Background: `graphite-900 #0B0F0E` with a faint topographic contour pattern at 6 % opacity
- A Supercurvy route line in `#C25CFF` sweeping across the lower third, with `#B4FF39` and
  `#22C9EE` route lines behind it at reduced opacity
- Wordmark **RideJaunm** in Space Grotesk Bold 700, `#E9EFED`
- Tagline beneath in Inter Medium: *"राइड जाऔं — Let's go. The road knows the way."*
- A single `#FF1F3D` SOS dot, small, bottom-right — the only red on the card
